notable_absence.finding: The Prerequisites state the Search Admin role is required 'for the bucket where you want to create the alias' - but the page immediately offers two endpoint choices, and the global endpoint's URL (`/api/index/${INDEX_NAME}`) names no bucket at all, unlike the scoped endpoint's `/api/bucket/${BUCKET_NAME}/scope/${SCOPE_NAME}/index/${INDEX_NAME}`. For a global alias whose targets span multiple buckets, the page never states which bucket's Search Admin role (if any single one) authorizes the create call, or whether a cluster-wide variant of the role is actually required. The same single Prerequisites sentence is reused unchanged from the single-bucket-scoped index/alias task pages, without being adapted for the global-alias case this page itself introduces.

cross_component_finding: This page and the sibling create-search-index-rest-api.md (server/7.2, already extracted) share verbatim Prerequisites wording for the Search Admin role requirement ('Your user account has the **Search Admin** role for the bucket where you want to create the index/alias') - the same pattern already noted in that record's own extraction. The alias REST page adds one genuinely new mechanism not present on the plain-index REST page at all: a closed choice between a 'scoped' and a 'global' creation endpoint, driven entirely by whether the alias's target indexes share a bucket and scope. This scoped/global split exists ONLY because an alias, unlike a plain index, can name targets outside its own bucket - it is a direct structural consequence of what an alias is (a pointer to other indexes) rather than an independent REST design choice, but no page states that connection explicitly. Separately: this page has NO Markdown link at all to create-search-index-alias.md (the UI-surface alias task, extracted at server/7.2/search/create-search-index-alias.json as search:create-search-index-alias) - despite being its REST-API counterpart for the same underlying task. The UI page's own prerequisites likewise link only to index:-aliases, create-search-index-ui, customize-index, simple-search-ui, and simple-search-rest-api - never to this REST page either. The two surfaces of one task do not cross-reference each other anywhere in the corpus; recorded here as a concept-membership relationship instead of a seeAlso, since no quotable link exists to support seeAlso.
